visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with glasses wearing a grey t-shirt holds a massive burger with approximately ten layers of beef and cheese in front of his face, smiling enthusiastically at the camera in a brightly lit indoor food court setting. (2) The scene cuts to a digital menu display for 'Burger King' showing options for 'BBQ Burger' with layers ranging from five to ten, including price points in NT$. (3) The man begins taking large, aggressive bites of the burger, squinting his eyes and leaning forward as he chews; a digital timer overlay begins counting up at the bottom of the screen. (4) Close-ups capture the man continuing the challenge, showing visible BBQ sauce on his lips and fingers while the layers of meat and cheese slowly diminish. (5) The man reaches the final portions of the burger, looking slightly fatigued but persistent, eventually swallowing the last bite and reaching for a stack of tissues on the table. (6) The final scene shows the man standing outdoors at night in front of an urban backdrop with glowing city lights, gesturing toward the camera while delivering a concluding message.
